pick.headline: Martial law declared in Poland
pick.summary: On December 13, 1981, General Wojciech Jaruzelski declared martial law in Poland; Solidarity's leaders were interned and the army and security forces took control.
pick.significance: The crackdown had been prepared in secret; the CIA had been forewarned by its agent on the Polish general staff, Colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, who had been exfiltrated weeks before. Washington imposed sanctions on Poland and the USSR.
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of December 14, 1981, listed Bulgarian and Hungarian coverage: "Jaruzelski Declares Martial Law in Poland", his speech, emergency laws and Western reaction, alongside Schmidt's GDR visit.
